basics.name: Stephen McNamara
basics.label: CEO / CTO — Payments & Crypto
basics.summary: Founder and technology executive with 30 years in payments and crypto, as CEO, CTO and co-founder. It's the early part I like best — the blank page, the first hires, the first paying customers. I've founded a venture-backed startup and sold it, grown engineering teams from the first hire to 100+, and I'm as happy owning the P&L as the technical detail underneath it.

work.name: Uphold
highlights: Report to the group CEO, leading a high-velocity team of 10 that takes 0→1 crypto-enabled financial products from idea to market.
Own the P&L for Uphold Vault, an assisted self-custody product since extended into inheritance: past $1m/yr in subscription revenue, with zero downtime and zero loss of customer funds.

work.name: OMG Network / SYNQA
work.position: EVP Strategy, then Chief Operating Officer
highlights: Shipped Tesuji Plasma, one of the first working Plasma child-chain implementations on Ethereum, establishing the network as a Layer 2 pioneer.
Led delivery of OMG Network V1 mainnet beta — protocol from testnet to production, and the rebrand of OmiseGO into OMG Network.
Launched a Plasma-based P2P payment network at up to 4,000 TPS and ~90% lower fees than Ethereum mainnet; the architecture was selected by Tether for its stablecoin sidechain.

work.name: Rakuten
highlights: Established and grew the Belfast blockchain lab following Rakuten's acquisition of Bitnet's IP, delivering DLT prototypes and a production Bitcoin wallet services suite with group teams in Tokyo.

work.name: Bitnet Technologies
highlights: Co-founded an enterprise bitcoin payment processor for large merchants; raised a $14.5m Series A led by Highland Capital Partners, with Rakuten and Digital Currency Group participating.
Took the platform to production across Rakuten's US, German and Austrian marketplaces; IP and team acquired by Rakuten in 2016.

work.name: Visa / CyberSource
highlights: Ran technology for a platform serving 295,000+ merchants and roughly a quarter of all US e-commerce spend at the time of Visa's $2bn acquisition.
Set the post-acquisition technology strategy and delivered a new platform architecture, developer API suite and data analytics R&D programme.

work.name: CyberSource
highlights: Founded CyberSource's Belfast development centre from zero — hired and trained an engineering and product organisation of 100+, with new products in market inside the first year.
